cohort: Teenage mothers and their fetuses receiving care at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology in Sree Mookambika Institute of Medical Sciences from February 2023 to January 2024.
finding: Teenage pregnancy was found to have adverse effects on both mothers and their babies, being more common among rural women, those aged 18-19 years, and individuals with lower socio-economic and educational status.
